title: docs: add AI Skills documentation pages and navigation
body:
The official docs site was missing coverage of the Skills System — the 10 domain-specific knowledge modules in `skills/` that teach AI assistants (Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) the ObjectStack protocol. The `concepts` section was also not wired into top-level navigation.

### New pages

- **`content/docs/concepts/skills.mdx`** — Conceptual overview: why skills exist, three-layer architecture (SKILL.md → rules → evals), skill boundary/delegation diagram, design philosophy
- **`content/docs/guides/skills.mdx`** — Complete reference for all 10 skills (Quickstart, Schema, Query, API, UI, Automation, AI Agent, Plugin, I18n, Hooks) with coverage summary, usage guidance, boundary tables, and example prompts

### Navigation updates

- `content/docs/meta.json` — Added `concepts` to top-level nav (was missing)
- `content/docs/concepts/meta.json` — Added `skills` between `architecture` and `core`
- `content/docs/guides/meta.json` — Added `skills` after `ai-capabilities`
- `content/docs/index.mdx` — Added "AI Skills System" card to Build section
- `content/docs/guides/index.mdx` — Added skills row to Building Applications table
